description:
Approved by the user 2026-11-17 (relayed by JSON) from the JSON machine-code study (fz vs BEAM JIT, lldb single-step traces). Study files: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz/ebbfffd8-2561-4da7-bcda-f9a316d00a1e/scratchpad/jsonasm/ (listings/, listings/beam/, CLIF dumps).

Evidence: 15 of ~25 instructions in an inline allocation are five read-modify-writes to process offsets 0x160, 0x170, 0x178, 0x1b0, 0x1b8, on every continuation and every box. Source: place_cont_closure and the alloc path in src/compiler2/native_codegen/closure.rs.

Fix: count on the slow (refill) path, or derive the counts from the bump-pointer distance per block. heap_alloc_stats stays exact (pins read it).

Related: fz-9x7.16 (runtime reports in-use and idle bytes, GC session). Agree the counting design with GC before building.
title: Allocation statistics leave the inline allocation path
